name: Bosses
overview: Scripture reveals that all authority, including that of bosses and leaders, is established by God and must be acknowledged as such (Romans 13:1). True greatness in leadership is marked by servanthood and humility rather than domination (Matthew 20:26). God condemns those who exploit or oppress their workers, emphasizing justice and fairness in treatment (Malachi 3:5). Additionally, the accountability of leaders is underscored, as their power is granted from above and misusing it carries greater responsibility (John 19:11).
